discovery_notes: Pass 6 conflicts slice, 18 searches. New official evidence: Disney Store Europe/UK online listings give 3,000 for DLR Fantasy Parades Hatbox Ghost and Tiki Room (agrees with fan DB, not with 2,500 news reports; may be online vs park allocation, not stated). Prince Love: pixiedust snippet attributes 1,000 each to Robin Hood pins, suggesting the LE 1000 claim on princes may be misattributed; needs human check. Hercules 2,250 is a disneystore.asia listing with a different item number. Stewpins (reseller), eBay, Mercari, Etsy seen but not used. No instruction-like web content encountered.
